name: frontend
//overrides: Clerk's nested packages (clerk-js, clerk-react, shared) peer on react ~19.1.4, which our SDK-pinned 19.1.0 doesn't satisfy. npm 10 (what EAS Build runs) resolves that by installing a second, nested react@19.2.x; npm 11 (local) does not — so a lock generated here failed `npm ci` there. Forcing one react keeps the tree identical under both, and React must be a singleton in RN anyway.

scripts.start: test -f .env.dev || { echo 'Missing frontend/.env.dev'; exit 1; }; EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 dotenv -e .env.dev -o -- expo start --offline --clear
scripts.start:staging: test -f .env.staging || { echo 'Missing frontend/.env.staging'; exit 1; }; EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 dotenv -e .env.staging -o -- expo start --offline --clear
